name: Beyond the Limits: Chapter One — The Neverending World
description: Minecraft stops being Minecraft. Rifts tear open in the fabric of space and time, the Overworld bleeds into other realities, an Observer follows you from the fog, the sky is a lie, and everything you build is remembered by the world itself. Chapter One of Beyond the Limits: a reality-collapse survival experience with custom dimensions, procedural real-world mutation, GLSL-driven rifts, dimensional storms, evolutionary mobs and a seamless gate into the Backrooms.
